heading: Privacy notice
paragraphs: This page doesn't ask for or store any personal data. The music settings you pick (sound on or off, and the volume) are kept in your own browser only.

When you sign up, the Tezera app stores the details you give it: your email address or phone number, date of birth, password and role. We use them only to create, verify and run your account. We never sell them, and you can ask us to delete your account at any time at {email}.
